Task: Melting of Magnesium
Description: Simulate the melting of Magnesium by first equilibrating the system under NVT conditions, then relaxing it under NPT conditions, followed by a heating stage under NPT where the temperature is gradually increased to induce melting. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential and the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 5 times in each direction. Report the final density of the system in g/cm³.

Required submission format:
numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)

All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL.

{"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/melting/brief/tasks/magnesium_melting_trial_3/in.melting", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for Mg melting simulation

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data mg.data

# Replicate the system 5x5x5
replicate 5 5 5

# EAM potential for Mg
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Mg.eam.fs Mg

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-6 1.0e-8 1000 10000

# Set timestep
timestep 0.001

# Create velocity
velocity all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian

# NVT equilibration
fix 1 all nvt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1
thermo 100
run 10000
unfix 1

# NPT relaxation
fix 2 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run 10000
unfix 2

# NPT heating
fix 3 all npt temp 300.0 2000.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
dump 1 all custom 1000 dump.lammpstrj id type x y z
thermo 100
variable density equal density
variable temp equal temp
fix density_print all print 100 "${temp} ${density}" file density.txt screen no
run 20000
unfix 3

print "All done""}
